ns2:course.label: Pre-Student Tchng Experience
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 143) Early field experience in teacher education, including a practicum of observation, teacher aide, and teaching experiences in music. Thirty-two hours of early field experience are required for each 1 hour of credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Only 2 hours may be applied toward the degree. Prerequisite: Music education majors, or consent of instructor.
